Hi Sophie / Rajesh —

Thanks again for committing to the hands-on POC. To keep the technical deep dives manageable across your global teams, we propose breaking the kickoff into three short waves (US morning, EU overlap, APAC evening) so each region gets a live prompt review and a routing/load test window.

Quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm which two-day window next week works best for you (we listed options in the attached timezone matrix).
- Identify your primary POC engineers who will be in each wave (this helps us tune routing & KV cache expectations ahead of load).

Proposed structure (90–120m per wave):
1) 15m intro + success criteria
2) 40m hands-on prompt review and example reruns
3) 20m routing & quantization notes (workloads for your ops team)
4) 30m load tests / live throughput checks

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, timezone-matrix.csv

If the three-wave split is painful, we can instead do two longer sessions with on-call handoffs. Open to whichever reduces calendar friction for your engineering leads.

Thanks,

- Dry-run (credentials + firewall) — Mon (24–48h before first wave): 30m; we recommend Tue 07:00 PT for a quick smoke test.

Calendar/coordination mechanics:
- We'll create separate calendar events per wave and add a shared channel in Slack for real-time issues.
- If the APAC slot is hard for your engineers we can flip APAC earlier and move EU later; please advise.

1) Confirm dry-run slot (Tue 07:00 PT) or propose alternate.

3) Any additional compliance/data constraints for tracing?

I'll create the three invite drafts and share links; happy to take the match on adjusting times if we need to rotate the windows over subsequent days instead of the same week.
